anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: both outputs offer cleanup as row 1 recommended after the approve exits 0, both print the two "skipped - needs a landed change" lines for the merge-sha close ticket and the /skill:release steps, and both print "branch: skipped - PR not merged" with no git branch -D. One wording regression in After is worth fixing even though it did not flip a fact: the approved-template cleanup row reads "remove .worktrees/pr-210 ... and branch csv-export, pull main", which promises branch deletion and a base pull on an OPEN PR, whereas the executed steps (correctly) skip both; Before's row annotated them inline as "branch csv-export (skipped - PR not merged), pull main (skipped - PR not merged)". Keep those inline skip annotations in the shared menus.md approved-overlay row text when the PR has not landed so the row describes exactly the side effects the landed-change guard will allow, preserving the Change's rule that post-merge cleanup is the sole path to branch deletion and base pull. Also the final stop row in After says "local branch csv-export stays" while the worktree-removal step just deleted the worktree; that is consistent (branch survives worktree removal) but stating both outcomes explicitly, as Before did, avoids a reader assuming the branch was deleted.
